home.storyTitle: From the market in Addis to Nørrebro
home.storyP1: Miracle Habesha began with two suitcases full of berbere and coffee — and an idea that the taste of home should not be hard to find. Today we import directly from families and cooperatives in Eritrea and Ethiopia.
home.storyP2: We taste every harvest before it reaches the shelf. We know the names of the people who grow the spices, and we pay prices that make it possible for them to keep going.
home.recipesDescription: Classics that bring the whole family around one plate. We have gathered the ingredients — you bring the fire.

about.title: A piece of Habesha in Copenhagen
about.intro: We are a small family shop in Nørrebro with a deep love for Eritrean and Ethiopian cooking. Here you will find the ingredients we grew up with — and the stories that come with them.
about.p1: It started in 2019 with a small cellar stockroom, two suitcases and a standing agreement with a coffee producer in Yirgacheffe. Today we work with more than forty families and cooperatives across Eritrea and Ethiopia.
about.p2: We buy in small batches and taste everything before it reaches the shelf. The spices must smell like they did when we were children; the coffee must have the right acidity; the honey must be raw and unfiltered.
about.p3: The shop on Jægersborggade is still our heart. Neighbours, families and chefs meet here to shop, taste and talk about food. The online shop is built to feel the same — just with delivery across Europe.
about.value1Text: We buy as directly as possible and pay prices that can carry the next harvest.
about.value2Text: Small batches, clear origin and no shortcuts in flavour.
about.value3Text: We preserve traditions — from jebena coffee to the handwoven mesob.
about.year2019Text: The first little shop in Nørrebro with berbere, teff and coffee from two producers.
about.year2022Text: We begin working with cooperatives in Tigray and Amhara and open the webshop.
about.year2024Text: Lovely Loyalty makes it possible to earn points across store and online.
about.year2026Text: We now ship across the EU and expand with crafts and everyday essentials.
about.visitText: We are ready with coffee, tastings and good advice on building a complete meal.
about.quote: When you buy a spice blend here, you also buy a family's story.
about.storyTitle: From two suitcases to forty families
